subject: single carp under lotus shadow
art_direction: 一尾墨鲤侧身经过荷叶暗影，鳞片极少、鱼尾展开，灰绿水面留白。
visible_description: 一尾墨鲤侧身经过荷叶暗影，鳞片极少、鱼尾展开，灰绿水面留白。
composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Paint one carp gliding sideways beneath the edge of a broad lotus-leaf shadow. Its body is a tapered dark ink wash with only a few restrained scale marks; the tail spreads into two translucent strokes. Keep the eye tiny and the movement calm. Use gray-green diluted water shapes around the fish, leaving the center light and the background mostly bare paper. Square 1024x1024, with a clear central silhouette and no circular border. Original peaceful design, no lettering, logos, or watermark.
